question: Should the shared manifest-driven provider-entry contract become the approved long-term plugin-SDK boundary for these ten bundled providers?
rationale: The patch is mechanically well-covered but broadens a compatibility-sensitive SDK helper and consolidates setup/auth/catalog behavior across several provider owners; that contract direction needs explicit maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Accept the helper as the canonical provider-registration seam after required checks complete and owners confirm external-plugin compatibility expectations.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Keep the helper changes but defer any provider whose custom registration behavior should remain outside the shared contract.

options.title: Split SDK and provider migrations
options.body: Review the public helper contract in a focused PR, then migrate bundled providers in follow-up changes.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept the helper as the canonical provider-registration seam after required checks complete and owners confirm external-plugin compatibility expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies steipete as the contributor currently carrying the shared-helper and provider-entry consolidation.
